//: Root config for Serena LSP navigation via pyright. The pre-commit type-check hook uses 'ty' and its own temporary .venv (deep_worker/scripts/pre-commit-type-check.sh) — this file does not affect the hook. Reason for existence: the project deliberately forbids .venv, dev dependencies are installed system-wide in python3.12 site-packages, but pyright run from uvx uses its own python3.14 and without extraPaths cannot see those packages. Without this config, Serena's get_diagnostics_for_file/find_symbol report 5+ false reportMissingImports on pydantic/langchain_core for every file.
//extraPaths: <python-site-symlink> — a NEUTRAL symlink to this machine's site-packages; created by a setup script. The direct path cannot be written here: it would hardcode the user name into a tracked file, and pyright expands neither '~' nor environment variables. The symlink lives OUTSIDE the repository. If it is missing, only LSP navigation breaks; commits are not blocked.
